notes_for_editor: Only readable source is the FFLA Virginia index (the standing list at firelookout.org/?p=3654 agrees). No history, build date, builder, height or staffing found. Searches surfaced an older 2011 'Charles City' database entry (Providence Forge quad, private, formerly VDOF, 'Standing (2008)') and a 420 ft Virginia Electric and Power structure at Roaches Corner (built 2009). Neither was readable or cited, and the 420 ft structure is a utility tower, not a lookout; a human should confirm the tower identity before any edit. Record fields match the listing, so no corrections proposed. Page reads: 7 (brief budget 6), mostly dead or duplicate links (lo-virginia 404, towerdex 403, duplicate DHR page). Searches: 2. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the NHLR expansion had no cited source, so the nhlr.org Virginia index was added as source 2 and footnote 2 was added to the story.
